title: Runtime and release evidence cannot be reproduced from the declared environment
description: Bundled Python lacks jsonschema, coverage, build, and twine; tests and self-checks cannot establish release readiness.
recommendation: Provide an isolated reproducible bootstrap and rerun all gates.
acceptance_criteria: 429+ tests, four self-checks, coverage, build, and wheel smoke pass

title: Source and packaged JSON resources differ byte-for-byte
description: Resource parity tests report CRLF packaged bytes versus LF source bytes.
recommendation: Use one canonical resource tree or deterministic normalization.
acceptance_criteria: Parity passes on Windows and Linux

title: Coverage output contract is inconsistent with tests
description: Tests expect SelectedControls while the writer serializes Coverage.to_dict without that key.
recommendation: Version and reconcile the coverage schema.
acceptance_criteria: Baseline exclusion and schema tests pass

title: Installed-plugin discovery lacks provenance policy
description: Any installed entry-point distribution may contribute operator-executed checks.
recommendation: Add compatibility, provenance, allowlist, and inventory controls.
acceptance_criteria: Unapproved or incompatible plugins fail closed or require explicit opt-in

title: Manifest integrity is not authenticity or confidentiality
description: SHA-256 manifest detects accidental tampering but is not independently authenticated and artifacts may contain sensitive configuration.
recommendation: Add optional signed manifests and redaction/encryption guidance.
acceptance_criteria: Signed verification detects altered manifest and artifacts

title: Historical execution reports can be mistaken for current evidence
description: Snapshots are dated but not bound to a lock hash and current checkout runtime could not reproduce them.
recommendation: Generate and label reports from CI with commit and environment identity.
acceptance_criteria: Each report includes commit, lock hash, interpreter, and validity status
